notes: Wraps the HTTP client of a test server rule in an Armeria RetryingClient (up to three attempts on unprocessed requests). The test method itself is not rerun. The target is the failing test named in line/decaton issue 187, which the PR says it fixes; the rule applies to every test in the class.
